tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Brand red. Primary CTA fill (상담문의, 입점 상담), active nav text, accent word in titles, 3px accent rules, icon fill, red owned-brand card ground. White text on it = 5.2:1. On black only as a rule/fill or text ≥24px (3.8:1); smaller red text on black uses red-on-dark.

tokens.name: red-600
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of red-500 fills.

tokens.name: red-700
tokens.usage: Deep red. Full-bleed bands (입점 브랜드 혜택, 입점 상담 바). White text on it = 8.0:1.

tokens.name: red-900
tokens.usage: Shade under red-700 bands.

tokens.name: red-50
tokens.usage: Pale red tint for rare relief areas (cover, empty states). red-500 text on it = 4.6:1; ink = 16.8:1. Not a section ground.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Premium ground: featured pricing plan, black owned-brand card, dark bands. Text on it: surface (19.7:1), smoke (7.8:1), red-on-dark (5.4:1).

tokens.name: black-soft
tokens.usage: Raised surface and photo placeholder on black. surface text 17:1, smoke 6.8:1.

tokens.name: line-dark
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers on black and black-soft (decorative, no meaning).

tokens.name: smoke
tokens.usage: Secondary text on black / black-soft: spec labels, meta, eyebrows.

tokens.name: red-on-dark
tokens.usage: Red text under 24px on black (5.4:1), e.g. a 'RECOMMENDED' eyebrow. Never on white.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface, surface-muted and red-50 (≥16:1). Logo hexagon.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: section descriptions, stat labels, brand captions-meta, footer text. 5.3:1 on surface, 5.0:1 on surface-muted.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background; card and tile fill; text on red-500 / red-700 / night.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Footer ground, alternate section ground, image placeholders.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Hero overlay ground (night city photo). Text on it: surface (18.7:1) or night-muted.

tokens.name: night-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and service icons on night (11.7:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between stats, footer rules, card outlines on surface.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of outline buttons (전체 브랜드 보기) and inputs: ≥3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px surface offset; reads on surface, red-50 and red fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on red-500, red-700 and red-900.

families.sans: "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Hero headline, max 3 lines; the brand name line in red-500.

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Major section heading; last phrase in red-500.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: Brand-list section title with crown/star icon.

styles.name: title-band
styles.usage: Centered title on red-700 band, flanked by hairlines.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Plan price figure (tabular-nums), ink on surface / surface on black. Unit 만원 in price-unit beside it.

styles.name: price-unit
styles.usage: Unit and period after the price figure; the period in ink-muted / smoke.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase Latin kicker above plan names, card meta (BOOTH, OWNED). Never Korean.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: 좋은 브랜드와 좋은 사람을 연결하는 프랜차이즈 창업 컨설팅 그룹

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Benefit tile labels, button text, nav CTA.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Brand tile captions, tags, stat labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside small labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Caption under brand image; inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Brand grid gutter; benefit tile gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (small); mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; header row gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between section header and grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Vertical padding inside bands.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section-to-section spacing.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width; centered with space-6 side padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Brand image tiles, tags, logo slot.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, benefit tiles, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: CTA box.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Pricing plans and owned-brand cards: square corners read as print, not app.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Dots, round icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Benefit tiles and brand tiles on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Featured pricing plan and owned-brand cards on hover only.
